entities.summary: Dan Costache (Dinu) Patriciu was a Romanian billionaire businessman and politician. At the time of his death, Patriciu was the richest man in Romania. His wealth was based on the Rompetrol company, which he took over from the Romanian state and later sold to Kazakhstan's state-owned KazMunayGas.
